description: Figure 2, captioned "Individual vs Ensemble Models," is a line plot that illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," is linearly scaled from 0 to 10, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," is linearly scaled from 30 to 90, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 20. The plot contains three distinct lines: a blue line with circular markers representing the "3-Model Ensemble," a red line with circular markers representing the "2-Model Ensemble," and a yellow line with circular markers representing "GPT-4." The blue line starts at a reliability score of approximately 80 when cost is 0 and decreases to about 75 at a cost of 10. The red line begins at approximately 85 when cost is 0 and decreases to about 75 at a cost of 10. The yellow line starts at a reliability score of 90 when cost is 0 and decreases sharply to approximately 40 at a cost of 10. All three lines show a downward trend as cost increases.
